title: Mixed Vegetable Salad

ingredients.title: For the Salad
items: Cucumber – 1 medium, finely chopped or diced
Carrot – 1 medium, grated or finely chopped

ingredients.title: For Dressing & Seasoning
items: Fresh coriander leaves – 1 tbsp, finely chopped
Roasted cumin powder (bhuna jeera) – ½ tsp
Black salt (kala namak) or regular salt – ¼ tsp, or to taste
Freshly ground black pepper – to taste

instruction.title: Prepare the Vegetables
steps: Finely chop or dice the cucumber, carrot, tomato, onion, capsicum, and raw mango if using.
Boil the green peas and potato if using.
Drain the peas and potato thoroughly and allow them to cool before adding to the salad.

instruction.title: Combine the Vegetables
steps: Add cucumber, carrot, tomato, onion, green peas, potato, capsicum, and raw mango if using to a large mixing bowl.
Toss gently to distribute the vegetables evenly.

instruction.title: Add the Seasoning
steps: Add chopped green chilies and fresh coriander.
Pour in the fresh lemon juice.
Add roasted cumin powder, chaat masala, black salt, and freshly ground black pepper.

instruction.title: Toss & Adjust
steps: Gently toss the salad until all the vegetables are evenly coated with the lemon juice and seasonings.
Taste and adjust salt, lemon juice, or chaat masala according to preference.

instruction.title: Chill & Serve
steps: Serve the salad immediately for maximum freshness.
Alternatively, refrigerate for 15–20 minutes before serving for a refreshing chilled salad.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds or roasted peanuts if desired.

chefTips: Vegetables: Use fresh, crisp vegetables for the best texture and flavor.
Cumin: Dry roast whole cumin seeds until fragrant, then grind them for a more aromatic bhuna jeera.
Crunch: Add pomegranate seeds or roasted peanuts for extra texture and flavor.
Mango: Raw mango adds a naturally tangy element and can be adjusted according to its sourness.
Serving: Dress the salad shortly before serving to prevent the vegetables from becoming watery.
Chilling: A brief 15–20 minute chill makes the salad especially refreshing while keeping the vegetables crisp.
